description: Calculates bounded GeoJSON loci on Earth where each selected major body is at a named angular condition at one UTC minute: AC (rising horizon), MC (upper meridian), DC (setting horizon), or IC (lower meridian). Useful for mapping, visualization, geographic research, and location-aware planning. It returns calculated geometry only, with no interpretation or prediction. Price: $0.02 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

bodies.description: One to four supported major-body names.

name: celestial_earth_projection
title: Global celestial geometry projection
